req.title: Task ids are monotonically increasing
req.statement: The system shall assign strictly increasing integer ids to newly created tasks.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that task IDs must be strictly increasing integers. This implies that each new task should have an ID greater than the previous one. The test suite will verify this behavior by creating tasks and checking their IDs. It will include a positive test to confirm the expected behavior, a negative test to handle potential errors, and a boundary test to ensure the system behaves correctly at the edge of its constraints.

tests.name: test_create_task_ids_monotonically_increasing
expected: The second task's ID is greater than the first task's ID.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Create first task
response1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task 1", "description": "First task", "completed": False})
assert response1.status_code == 201
first_task_id = response1.json()["id"]

# Create second task
response2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task 2", "description": "Second task", "completed": False})
assert response2.status_code == 201
second_task_id = response2.json()["id"]

# Assert that the second task ID is greater than the first
assert second_task_id > first_task_id

tests.name: test_create_task_with_invalid_data
actions: Attempt to create a task with invalid data (missing title).
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to create a task with missing title
response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"description": "No title", "completed": False})

# Assert that the response status code is 422

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary_case
actions: Create a task with the minimum valid title length.
expected: Task is created successfully with a valid ID.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a task with minimum valid title length
response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "T", "description": "Boundary test", "completed": False})

# Assert that the task is created successfully
assert response.status_code == 201
assert "id" in response.json()
assert response.json()["title"] == "T"
